regime_context: The TSX detector shows a broad resource-led rotation: Base Metals & Copper leads (score 1.70) with strong durability (0.7) and full breadth, while Gold Miners follows closely. The absolute-trend gate helped historically, and nearly all themes are eligible, suggesting a trend-following, risk-controlled posture. Macro backdrop is dominated by AI/tech headlines and unscheduled news (share 0.99), injecting uncertainty but not invalidating the resource tilt.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (XGD.TO) is a close challenger with a trend tag and durability of 0.79. Watch for a CONFIRMED leadership handoff: if the margin between Base Metals and Gold Miners narrows to below 0.2 and XGD.TO maintains durability above 0.7, a rotation toward precious metals may gain traction. Retire watch if margin widens back above 0.5 or Gold Miners' durability drops below 0.6.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is the top-ranked eligible theme (attention concentration) with full constituent participation and a durability bar of 0.7, signaling trend persistence. The theme is not crowded, reducing risk of a reflexive shake-out. The absolute-trend gate validates its uptrend, providing a historical drawdown-reduction benefit. This supports a modest overweight to capture continued leadership, while acknowledging no return-forecast edge from momentum alone.
theses.dissent: Base metals are highly cyclical; a global growth scare or risk-off shock (e.g., from geopolitical escalation) could cause a sharp reversal, irrespective of trend health.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes below its 50-day simple moving average and underperforms the S&P/TSX by more than 2% over any 5-day period before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
